tools.name: get_feed_mailbox

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_best_endpoint, create_feed, get_feeds, get_credit_balance, buy_credits, get_feed_mailbox, ack_feed_mailbox_item · Private data: request_data, call_routed_api, get_btc_data, get_weather, get_fx_data, get_airport_data, get_stock_data, get_market_insights, create_feed, delete_feed, buy_credits · Public sink: create_feed, get_feed_mailbox · Destructive: delete_feed, buy_credits, ack_feed_mailbox_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_best_endpoint, create_feed, get_feeds, get_credit_balance, buy_credits, get_feed_mailbox, ack_feed_mailbox_item · Private data: request_data, call_routed_api, get_btc_data, get_weather, get_fx_data, get_airport_data, get_stock_data, get_market_insights, create_feed, delete_feed, buy_credits · Public sink: create_feed, get_feed_mailbox · Destructive: delete_feed, buy_credits, ack_feed_mailbox_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
